## Market.liquidity property

**Signature:**

```typescript
get liquidity(): bigint;
```

## Remarks

Warning:

Cannot be used to calculate the liquidity available inside a callback, because the balance of Blue may be lower than the market's liquidity due to assets being transferred out prior to the callback.
